current.prior_exact_fingerprint_rationale: convertBatch clears source rights and debits source liability before conversion, then assigns exact received ETH by cumulative whole floors. nonReentrant rejects claims/credit/sync/conversion; claimableComponents, allocationTree and canonicalSeed read barriers reject intermediate accounting. Public mapping reads alone authorize no economic write; external token behavior is qualified separately.
